description: This PHP class file defines the FreeCheckout controller for the OpenCart admin extension, implementing functionality for displaying and saving free checkout payment settings within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Free Checkout payment extension settings in OpenCart's admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the Free Checkout payment method, setting up data and loading view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the payment extension configuration settings, returning success or error messages in JSON format.
